| Route | Stops |
|-------|-------|
| JFK ↔ LHR (New York – London) | Direct |
| JFK → MIA (New York – Miami) | Direct |
| LAX ↔ SFO (Los Angeles – San Francisco) | Direct |
| LAX ↔ LAS (Los Angeles – Las Vegas) | Direct |
| SEA ↔ SFO (Seattle – San Francisco) | Direct |
| SEA ↔ SAN (Seattle – San Diego) | Direct |
| SFO → LAS (San Francisco – Las Vegas) | Direct |
| LAS → SAN (Las Vegas – San Diego) | Direct |

Unfortunately, none of these routes connect to Boston. Could you share a bit more about your travel plans? For example:
